out.description: ndarray, None, or tuple of ndarray and None, optional A location into which the result is stored. If provided, it must have a shape that the inputs broadcast to. If not provided or None, a freshly-allocated array is returned. A tuple (possible only as a keyword argument) must have length equal to the number of outputs.

where.description: array_like, optional This condition is broadcast over the input. At locations where the condition is True, the `out` array will be set to the ufunc result. Elsewhere, the `out` array will retain its original value. Note that if an uninitialized `out` array is created via the default ``out=None``, locations within it where the condition is False will remain uninitialized. For other keyword-only arguments, see the :ref:`ufunc docs <ufuncs.kwargs>`.

output.description: ------- ndarray or bool True where ``x`` is NaN, false otherwise. This is a scalar if `x` is a scalar.
